title: Underground Coin Cache Structure for Villager Coin
description: Adds an Underground Coin Cache structure containing Coin Stacks from VillagerUnknown's Villager Coin mod.
body:
Adds an Underground Coin Cache structure to world generation containing Coin Stacks from VillagerUnknown's Villager Coin mod.

## Requirements

*   VillagerUnknown's Villager Coin mod
*   VillagerUnknown's Coin Stacks for Villager Coin mod

## Installation

1.  Download the ZIP file for your desired Minecraft version.
2.  Create your Minecraft World.
3.  Install the ZIP file in your Minecraft World's `datapacks` folder.
